name: Protein Function Prediction Benchmark (2024)
description: A comprehensive computational benchmark that measures how well deep learning methods predict protein functions across curated tasks and metrics.
evaluation_method: F1 / Fmax (max F-measure), precision/recall and AUROC
reputation: Recognized benchmark in computational biology with growing adoption for evaluating deep-learning protein function predictors.
notes: High risk of data leakage due to pretraining on large sequence databases (e.g., UniProt). Strong class imbalance and hierarchical label structure; performance varies by organism/ontology. Non-LLM domain.
